text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While passing by a general merchandise 
store, I happened to spot a horse girl 
browsing through the goods—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~ The color is super cute, but... I 
wish the texture was just a bit fluffier—

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—U-Um, excuse me! Could you possibly be... 
Curren?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yup! It's me, Curren☆!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text: I-I-It's really her...! Oh wow—

text_block_list.name: Female Customer A
text_block_list.text:
—Curren?! Seriously?! Wait, wait, wait, 
she's actually right here!!

text_block_list.name: Male Customer B
text_block_list.text:
I thought I recognized her, but it really 
is her...! She's insanely cute in 
person...!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, I watch your Umastagram all the 
time!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Me too! I've been a huge fan forever—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, Curren Chan was 
completely surrounded by fans who noticed 
her presence...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was only casually shopping, so I began 
to worry that things might spiral out of 
hand, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, running into each other here must be 
fate♪ Curren would love to snap a 
commemorative photo with you... what do 
you say?

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaat?! A-A two-shot photo?! A-Are you 
sure?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Curren wants to take photos 
with everyone else too~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but wait, wait~ We don't want to get 
in the shop's way, so let's line up over 
there and take turns♪

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fans
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan then graciously gave attentive 
care to each fan one by one—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving every single fan present thrilled 
and satisfied, all without a trace of 
chaos...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Hey there, Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes, you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You were worried about Curren and watching 
over me the entire time, weren't you?♪
choice_data_list: You take great care of your fans.
Is your shopping going to be okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You were worried about Curren and watching 
over me the entire time, weren't you?♪
choice_data_list: You take great care of your fans.
Is your shopping going to be okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ I just didn't want to disappoint the 
sweet fans who were excited to find 
Curren☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides~ interacting with everyone like 
that makes Curren look even cuter, don't 
you think!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Don't you agree, Trainer-san?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through her effortless charm, I caught a 
glimpse of the sheer, terrifying power of 
the "cute" that captivates so many 
fans...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep♪ It wasn't urgent anyway, and I 
figured "something like this might 
happen"☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Even so...—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Worrying about my shopping on top of 
that... Trainer-san, you really are such 
a~ super sweet person, aren't you...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From her casual words and actions, I could 
truly feel the tremendous power of the 
"cuteness" that captivated so many fans……!
